questions.question: How do I choose the right size?
questions.answer: Compare your foot measurements with any sizing guidance provided for the product. If you are unsure about the fit, contact our team before placing your order.

questions.question: Where can I find a specific product?
questions.answer: Browse the Shop and Collection pages to explore sneakers. For questions about a particular model or size, contact our team to confirm availability.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: Review the payment options shown at checkout before placing your order. Contact our team if you need clarification about an available method.

questions.question: How long does shipping take?
questions.answer: Review the available delivery information before completing your order. For questions about delivery estimates or an existing order, contact our team with your order details.

questions.question: Can I return or exchange an order?
questions.answer: Contact our team with your order details to confirm the applicable return or exchange conditions and next steps before sending an item back.

questions.question: How can I contact the Step & Repeat team?
questions.answer: Reach us by email at contact@stepandrepeat.com or call +40 766 542 882. You can also use the contact form below and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
